licence.title: License to practice as a physician assistant
licence.renewalDeadline: Before the licence expiration date, two years after issuance (not a fixed calendar date); unrenewed licence is automatically suspended on expiry
licence.renewalWindow: Renewal may be submitted up to 180 days before expiry; emails at 90, 60 and 30 days (State Medical Board PA page)

ce.categoryRules: 100 hours of CME per 2-year licensure period (OAC 4730-1-06(G)(2)); courses acceptable for NCCPA certification satisfy it; prorated to 50, 25 or 0 hours for a licence issued partway through the period. PAs with a prescriber number also need 12 hours of Category I pharmacology every 2 years, in addition.

topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs holding a valid prescriber number (physician-delegated prescriptive authority); Category I; Board-approved; in addition to the 100 hours; prorated to 6, 3 or 0 hours at the first renewal after the 500 on-site supervision hours

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: None separate; prescribers of opioid analgesics or benzodiazepines must certify OARRS (drug database) access at renewal

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written supervision agreement signed by the supervising physician and PA before supervision begins; each keeps a copy. Not filed with the Board and has no expiration or renewal (State Medical Board PA page). Amendable at any time.
practice.notes: Supervising physician is legally responsible for the PA's services.
practice.qualityAssurance: Supervising physician quality assurance review of selected PA records and orders at least twice in the PA's first year of practice, then at least once a year; records kept 7 years (OAC 4730-1-05).

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Prescriber number issued by the State Medical Board; prescriptive authority is physician-delegated
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 12 hours pharmacology every 2 years (ORC 4730.49(A)(1)); DEA registration if delegated controlled substance authority; OARRS access certification at renewal for opioid or benzodiazepine prescribers
prescribing.onSiteSupervision: First 500 hours of prescriptive authority under on-site supervision (OAC 4730-2-04(B)) unless 1,000 hours of prescribing in another jurisdiction is documented

rn.renewalDeadline: Odd-numbered years; application due September 15, licence lapses November 1

topicMandates.topic: Ohio nursing law and rules (Category A)

rn.ceNote: No CE required for the first renewal after licensure by examination; 12 hours if licensed by endorsement for one year or less

aprn.title: APRN designated as certified nurse practitioner (APRN-CNP)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate APRN licence (requires current Ohio or compact RN licence)
aprn.renewalDeadline: Odd-numbered years; application due September 15, licence lapses November 1
aprn.ceNote: 24 APRN hours are IN ADDITION to the 24 RN hours; CE completed for national certification counts toward both if from a Board-approved source. No APRN CE is required for the first renewal after the APRN licence is first issued (OAC 4723-8-10(B)(3)); the RN CE waiver cannot be used for APRN hours (4723-8-10(D)); up to 8 hours may be volunteer care to indigent and uninsured patients
aprn.pharmacologyNote: At least 12 of the 24 APRN hours in advanced pharmacology from an accredited institution recognized by the Board (CNPs, CNMs, CNSs)

prescribing.notes: Prescriptive authority comes with the CNP designation and is exercised under the standard care arrangement and the Board formulary (OAC 4723-9-10); OARRS review provisions must be in the standard care arrangement

practice.agreementType: standard care arrangement with collaborating physician or podiatrist
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Written standard care arrangement with each collaborating physician or podiatrist, retained by the employer; no prior Board approval. Names and addresses of collaborating physicians submitted to the Board within 30 days of starting practice and within 30 days of any change, and listed on each renewal. Arrangement records its initial execution date and most recent review date; new arrangement required for a different or additional employer. A collaborating physician may collaborate in prescribing with no more than five nurses at once.
practice.qualityAssurance: Random chart review including prescribing patterns at least annually by a collaborating physician or physician-led QA committee, with a chance to discuss feedback, and a patient evaluation process (OAC 4723-8-05(C)). Any change to the body of the standard care arrangement requires reapproval; prior arrangements kept 3 years (OAC 4723-8-04(D)(7)(a),(F)).

unverified: PA and NP state controlled substance registration: no Ohio statute or rule requiring an individual prescriber state CS registration was found; a terminal distributor of dangerous drugs licence for personally furnishing was not researched. Show as not yet verified with https://www.pharmacy.ohio.gov.

PA: the State Medical Board PA page lists only NCCPA certification and the 12 pharmacology hours under Continuing Education and does not mention the 100 hours in OAC 4730-1-06(G)(2); the rule is the controlling primary source and NCCPA courses satisfy it.
PA: ORC 4730.14(A) says the licence expires two years after issuance; OAC 4730-1-06 speaks of a 'licensure registration period' with proration by month. Use the expiry date on the licence.
NP: 'reduced' is the AANP label; primary sources confirm a required standard care arrangement with a collaborating physician or podiatrist.

PA and NP: no Ohio topic mandate (opioid/pain, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, Alzheimer, suicide prevention, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence) was found for PAs (ORC 4730.14, 4730.49, OAC 4730-1-06) or APRNs (ORC 4723.24, OAC 4723-8-10). For RNs, 1 hour Category A (Ohio nursing law) is mandatory; 1 hour on human trafficking or sexual assault victims may count but is optional (OAC 4723-14-03(J)). OARRS access certification at renewal applies to PA opioid or benzodiazepine prescribers. Federal DEA MATE (one-time 8 hours) still applies to DEA registrants.
corrections: PA CE hours: WRONG in research. Researcher said Ohio sets no state hour count; OAC 4730-1-06(G)(2) (effective October 31, 2025) requires 100 hours of CME per licensure period, satisfiable by NCCPA-acceptable courses, prorated 50/25/0 for licences issued mid-period. hoursPerCycle changed from null to 100, cycleYears 2.
PA pharmacology: added that the 12 hours must be Category I (OAC 4730-1-06(H)(2)) and are prorated to 6/3/0 at the first renewal after the 500 on-site supervision hours (H)(4).
PA: ORC 4730.14(B)(1) expressly requires 'passing periodic recertification examinations' (PANRE/PANRE-LA) as part of maintained NCCPA certification; recorded.
PA: MISSED recurring requirement added: supervising physician quality assurance review at least twice in the PA's first year and at least yearly after, records kept 7 years (OAC 4730-1-05).
PA: MISSED requirement added: first 500 hours of prescriptive authority under on-site supervision (OAC 4730-2-04(B), ORC 4730.44).
PA: State Medical Board page confirms supervision agreements are not filed and have no expiration or renewal; renewal can be filed up to 180 days before expiry.
NP: added that no APRN CE is due at the first APRN renewal after initial issuance and the RN waiver does not apply to APRN hours (OAC 4723-8-10(B)(3),(D)).

NP: MISSED recurring requirement added: random chart review including prescribing patterns at least annually under the standard care arrangement quality assurance process (OAC 4723-8-05(C)(1)). The researcher's note that no review frequency exists was true only of the SCA document itself.
NP: added SCA reapproval on modification and 3-year retention of prior SCAs (OAC 4723-8-04), and gave the five-nurse prescribing cap its own primary quote (ORC 4723.431(A)(1)).
NP/RN: OAC 4723-14-03 re-loaded at its March 26, 2026 version; 24 hours with 1 hour Category A still current.
